Use case: illustration-story. A NEW creative storyboard for Goji Girl Episode 02. This is a sheet of ORIGINAL PS2 GRAND THEFT AUTO SAN ANDREAS GAMEPLAY/CUTSCENE FRAMES adapted to Singapore, not modern promotional concept art.
IMAGE ROLES: first reference image = canonical Goji Girl identity (adult woman, maroon sleeveless top/leggings, long black ponytail, white trainers, one small black structured handbag with gold clasp). Other supplied original PS2 screenshots = render/look and gameplay-camera authority ONLY, never replace her with CJ or use their countryside. Retain identity from first image.
LOOK: closely match original 2004 PS2 GTA San Andreas, low-resolution painted clothing/road/facade textures, economical face geometry, simple hair mesh, broad diffuse and vertex-lit surfaces, restrained fake specular, simple alpha-card trees, cyan sky and muted ochre/green Singapore environment with moderate distance haze. Every NPC shares the same PS2 mesh/texture fidelity. Adult realistic proportions with simple game meshes. NO modern cinematic lighting, glossy PBR, Pixar faces, clay models, bare polygon diorama, highly faceted origami skin, photoreal detail, bokeh or depth-of-field. Avoid the remaster and GTA V look. Image should feel like playing the original game.
LAYOUT: portrait page approx 9:16, exactly FOUR separate panels in a TWO-column TWO-row grid. Each panel itself must be a TALL 9:16 gameplay/cutscene viewport, not square. Thin black gutters, a tiny white panel number at top left. No title, captions, speech bubbles or illustrative motion lines. Leave HUD out except exactly one small wanted star in indicated panels; final HUD is added separately. The frames are composed vertically, not stretched.
CAMERA RULE FOR OUTDOORS: ordinary third-person PLAYER camera looking forward from behind the controllable woman; full body below centre, enough road/world ahead. For driving, camera follows the REAR of the bus, looking FORWARD down its direction of travel; rear engine grille and taillights nearest viewer, front of bus points AWAY. Level horizon, mildly elevated, consistent follow distance, no front-facing car commercial shots, no Dutch angles, no low hero angle, no drone or cinematic crane. Player remains the centre of attention. Singapore left-hand traffic, right-hand driving cab; do not mirror signage or character. Non-graphic absurd game comedy, no blood or deaths.
This is sheet A with panels 01,02,03,04 in reading order.
01: INDOOR cutscene allowed. Medium over-shoulder view of canonical woman at modest Singapore home work desk, wearing small black headset with visible microphone, laptop screen clearly video meeting with six blocky adult faces, visibly frustrated. Phone notification icon beside laptop. Black handbag on desk side. PS2 cutscene geometry and textures, no modern glossy illustration.
02: INDOOR cutscene allowed. Medium side three-quarter same desk, she angrily rips off headset with one hand and slams laptop shut with other. Exact same adult woman, coarse game face and painted textures. Bag remains at desk edge. No anime action lines.
03: gameplay resumes: eye-level THIRD-PERSON PLAYER view FROM DIRECTLY BEHIND her, full body occupies lower 40–45% of viewport. She busts the front door open in front of her with right hand and moves OUT toward the street with gangster swagger, black handbag IN LEFT HAND. Camera follows from hallway through door; level horizon, generous surroundings visible, NOT low closeup at feet. She faces AWAY from viewer.
04: third-person player view behind same woman running TOWARD stationary bus at busy Singapore stop. Same modest follow height/distance and fullbody screen size as 03. White single-deck bus with purple lower body/red roof band and its LEFT passenger doors open, blocky adults alighting, last commuters clear. She curves around FRONT NOSE toward RIGHT driver's cab, camera follows woman from BEHIND, a little rear-three-quarter allowed so passing nose and open left door readable. Black handbag left hand. No one faces camera as a hero pose. No wanted star yet. Urban concrete sheltered walkway, HDB, simplified tropical trees.
